basicInfo.name: Tanjiro Kamado
basicInfo.flavor: Tanjiro is a kind-hearted boy who, after his sister was transformed into a demon, joined the Demon Slayer Corps to turn her back into a human again. In addition to Water Breathing, he also wields the Hinokami Kagura and possesses an extraordinarily keen sense of smell. Even as he fell into the Infinity Castle, he vowed to his nemesis, Muzan Kibutsuji, that he would \"definitely defeat him.\

Normal Attack.desc:
Single Enemy
 - Deals damage equal to 145% of Physical Attack 1 time(s).
 - 50% chance to inflict Burn. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 145% of Physical Attack.

Skill 1.desc:
3 Enemies
 - For each buff on the target, adds additional damage equal to 9% of Physical Attack to each attack. [Max 8 Stack(s)]
 - Deals Defense-Ignoring damage equal to 110% of Physical Attack 2 time(s).
 - Each attack has a 55% chance to inflict Burn. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 110% of Physical Attack.

Skill 2.desc:
All Enemies
 - 100% chance to inflict Block Rate Reduction. [Duration: 3 Turn(s)]
 - 100% chance to inflict 2 Buff Removal(s).
 - For each debuff on the target, adds additional damage equal to 4% of Physical Attack to each attack. [Max 8 Stack(s)]
 - Deals damage equal to 38% of Physical Attack 3 time(s).
 - Each attack has a 30% chance to inflict Burn. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
 - Self
 - Grants Skill Cooldown Reset when an enemy falls in battle.
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 38% of Physical Attack.

Passive.desc:
Self
 - Grants All Damage Nullification. [Ends After: Taking 3 Hit(s)]
 - Revives with Indomitable upon falling in battle. [Ends After: Taking 8 Hit(s)] [Once per Battle]
 - Activates Transparent World upon activating Indomitable [Always Active]
 - Grants Crit Damage Boost upon activating Indomitable. [Duration: 3 Turn(s)]
 - Allies (Attack)
 - Activates Delayed Buff. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
 - Grants Effect Hit Rate Boost. [Always Active]
 - All Enemies
 - Inflicts Physical Vulnerability. [Always Active]
Transcend Lv.2 Effect
 - Self
 - Increases Indomitable's hit count by 2 hit(s) when enemies fall in battle.
Transcend Lv.6 Effect
 - Self
 - Changes Effect: Activates Transparent World at the start of battle. [Always Active]

Awaken Skill.name: Hinokami Kagura: Setting Sun Transformation
Awaken Skill.desc:
Single Enemy
 - Deals damage equal to 147% of Physical Attack 4 time(s).
 - Activates again up to 1 time(s) with 100% power upon defeating an enemy with this skill.
 - Allies (Attack)
 - Grants All Damage Nullification. [Ends After: Taking 3 Hit(s)]
 - Activates Delayed Buff. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Allies (Attack)
 - Adds Effect: Grants All Damage Nullification. [Ends After: Taking 3 Hit(s)]
 - Adds Effect: Delayed Buff. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
